item.title: Why Chile Is So Long and Thin
item.description: Chile runs 4,270 km from north to south but is only 177 km wide on average. The two halves of that shape have two different explanations: the Andes made Chile thin, and nearly four centuries of conquest, war and treaties made it long. Watch the full story on YouTube: Map Behind History. #chile #whyischilesolong #history #geography #maps

item.title: How Istanbul Ended Up on Two Continents
item.description: Istanbul spans Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus. Greek settlers from Megara first founded Chalcedon on the Asian shore; according to Strabo, an oracle later told the founders of Byzantium to build "opposite the blind", which they took to mean Chalcedon, and they settled the far better European site. Watch the full story on YouTube: Map Behind History. #istanbul #bosphorus #history #geography #maps
